after.description: [Mozio] - The Promo code amount is NOT displayed as expected for Return trip tickets in the Mozio email confirmation. When a booking includes a return trip with an applied promo code, the discount amount and name do not appear in the Mozio email confirmation for the return leg, while they should be shown just as they are for one-way/outbound trips.
after.title: [Mozio] - Promo code amount not displayed for Return trip tickets in Mozio email confirmation

notes: Defect: promo code discount amount is missing or incorrect for return trip tickets in Mozio email confirmations. The codebase shows discount is optional in SanitizedMozioDispatch and return-trip-specific mappers exist that may drop discount data. Acceptance criteria were empty — derived from description.

notes: Openspec provided empty acceptance criteria with a note deriving context from the description. I created all criteria from scratch based on the defect description and technical notes. Key additions: (1) core fix criteria for both discount amount and name on return trips (AC1-2), (2) regression safeguard for outbound/one-way trips (AC3), (3) negative case — no promo code on return trip should not show ghost fields (AC4), (4) both-legs scenario to ensure independent rendering (AC5), (5) return-trip modification path since map-line-item-return-trip-modification.ts is listed in technical notes (AC6), (6) partial/missing discount data edge case since the defect may stem from optional discount fields being dropped (AC7), (7) non-negative discount validation as a data integrity safeguard (AC8).
